title: Crystal Clear Bar Salts Red Apple Ice Nic Salts 10ml E-Liquid
description: Crystal Clear Red Apple Ice Nic Salt delivers the juicy crunch of Red Apple with a cooling exhale. The Apple note is crisp and gently sweet, while the Ice element keeps things clean and refreshing on the finish. An easy all-day vape with a fruit-first profile. Blended at a 50VG/50PG ratio, this Nic Salt e-liquid is designed for MTL (mouth-to-lung) pod kits and vape pens. Choose from 10mg or 20mg strengths for a smooth throat hit and fast-acting nicotine delivery. Crystal Clear Nic Salts are crafted to deliver the same great-tasting flavours that made disposable vapes so popular, now reimagined for refillable pod kits. Designed for clarity, consistency and convenience, this UK-made range focuses on fruity, icy, and confectionery-inspired blends that cater to everyday vapers.
